title: Hallelujah and the Marriage of the Lamb
description: A great multitude in heaven praises God with shouts of hallelujah for his righteous judgment against the great prostitute. The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fall down and worship God who sits on the throne, and a voice from the throne calls all servants to praise. The crowd rejoices that the marriage of the Lamb has come, and the bride has made herself ready, clothed in shining, pure fine linen – the righteous acts of the saints. Blessed are those invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb. When John falls down to worship the angel, he is stopped with these words: Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
